name: BLINDED by DELIGHT
description: BLINDED by DELIGHT is a memory of happiness that overwhelms all the senses. Join Luci on her emotional journey into the world of dreams in this fantastically beautiful Grand Show at Europe's largest theater stage. The Friedrichstadt-Palast represents the apex of Berlin's spectacular theatrical tradition, combining massive production values with emotional depth. This is a full-scale theatrical experience that goes beyond entertainment to create a total sensory immersion.
